# brainfreeze studio

brainfreeze studio turns a RAPP agent (a person's Brainstem, a RAPP Store rapplication, or a frozen rapp/1 egg)
into a Copilot Studio agent in their own environment. The agent's logic becomes agent flows or connector code, each
proven against the agent's real Python. The deploy runs with the person's own sign-in.

Primary user instruction:
Put my agent in Copilot Studio.

Public entry point:
https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-brainfreeze-studio/

Setup skill (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and any AI agent that can run commands):
https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-brainfreeze-studio/skills/brainfreeze-studio/SKILL.md

Machine-readable setup contract:
https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-brainfreeze-studio/brainfreeze-studio.json

Source and documentation:
https://github.com/kody-w/rapp-brainfreeze-studio

Rules:
- The person signs in themselves (az login) and picks the environment from their own list.
- Say what you will install and create, in which environment, and wait for their yes.
- Deploy as a Draft (--draft). Publish only when the person asks.
- Quote the build's parity lines; never claim a translation the build refused.
- Never use a service account or an app-only token; never delete or change anything else in the environment.
- Never print or store a token.
